profile.ja:
“ふうま八将”黒谷家当主。黒谷将監の娘。
父とともに魔界を放浪、武者修行していたという武闘派。
視界内であれば瞬時に移動できる邪眼“天駆馬”の使い手。
天駆馬を使い瞬間移動しながら戦闘をするほか、奥義として自分が放ったエネルギーを瞬間移動させることもできる。
得物の“鳴神”は魔界産の金属でできた魔法の金砕棒で、強力な電撃を放つが、一度放つとしばらくチャージ時間が必要となる。
現在はふうま小太郎を宗家当主と仰ぎ五車学園に（たまに）通っている。
学食のあんぱんが大好物で、学園にいる際はいつもモグモグしている。
profile.en: She is the head of the Kurotani family, one of the "Fuuma Eight Generals". She is Kurotani Shogen's daughter. Along with her father, she has been wandering the Demon Realm, undergoing warrior training, and is known for her martial prowess. She wields the "Tenkuma" evil eye, which allows her to move anywhere within her line of sight instantly. Using the Tenkuma, she can not only move around during combat but also teleport the energy she releases as a secret technique. Her weapon, "Narukami", is a magical gold club made from a metal produced in the Demon Realm, capable of unleashing powerful electrical attacks, although it requires a charging period after each use. Currently, she looks up to Fuuma Kotaro as the head of the main Fuuma family and occasionally attends Gosha Academy. She has a great fondness for the anpan served at the school cafeteria and is often eating it when she is at the academy.

text.ja: ふうま八将黒谷家当主、黒谷甲斐。黒谷は弱き主君には仕えない、ふうま宗家の当主よ、その実力を示してもらおう
text.en: I'm Kurotani Kai, the head of the Kurotani family, one of the Fuuma Eight Generals. The Kurotani family won't serve a weak master - I'd like to see the head of the Fuuma family demonstrate their abilities.

text.ja: 魔界での放浪修行が長かっただけに学園生活というものは興味深い。特にこのあんパンは格別だ。あんぅ、モグモグ……
text.en: The wandering training in the Demon Realm was long, so I find this school life interesting. Especially this anpan - it's exceptional. Mmm, I'm just going to keep eating...

text.ja: 親父殿がなんと言おうと黒谷の当主は私だ。私はふうまの当主殿の力を認めた、その事実は変わらない
text.en: No matter what my father says, I am the head of the Kurotani family. I have acknowledged the power of the head of the Fuuma family, and that fact won't change.

text.ja: 五車学園は強者揃いで楽しい。直接戦闘で私を上回る先生もいることだし、しばらくはこの学園に通わせてもらう
text.en: Gosha Academy is full of strong individuals, and it's fun. There are even teachers who can surpass me in direct combat, so I'll be attending this academy for a while.

text.ja: 力だけでいえば私のほうが上だが、当主殿はそれ以上の可能性を秘めている。私はそこが気に入ったんだ
text.en: If we're talking about strength alone, I'm superior, but the head of the Fuuma family has potential beyond that. That's what I like about them.

text.ja: 当主殿、学食へ行くのか？　ならば私も同行しよう。あんパンを買いに……いや、当主殿の護衛としてな
text.en: Are you going to the cafeteria, Head? If so, I'll accompany you. To buy anpan... no, to serve as your escort.

text.ja: 金砕棒・鳴神は魔界産の金属、オリハルコン製だ。一度放つと充電が必要なのが難点だが、それでもこの電撃は強力なんだ
text.en: The gold club, Narukami, is made from orichalcum, a metal from the Demon Realm. Once I use it, I need to recharge, which is a drawback, but this electrical attack is still very powerful.

text.ja: 天駆馬の神髄は視界内のいかなるものも一度に、あるいは分散させて瞬間移動できることにある
text.en: The essence of the Tenkuma lies in its ability to teleport anything within my line of sight instantly, either all at once or scattered.

text.ja: 私は当主殿の嫁になるため、男の悦ばせ方を学んできた。オイルを全身に塗って、ああぁ～、身体を重ねる……！
text.en: I've been learning how to please men in order to become the head's wife. I'll apply oil all over my body and... ah, overlap our bodies...

text.ja: 私から、セックスしよう……！　ンああっ、チンポをマンコに……んんん！　自分から入れて、くはァ！
text.en: Let's have sex...! Ah, I'll take your penis in my vagina...! I'll insert it myself, and... kuha!

text.ja: ハァハァ、当主殿……まだマンコの中でチンポがギンギン！？　私はイッたばかりで、もう一回なんてそんな……ひイ！
text.en: Ha ha, Head... your penis is still hard inside me!? I've just come, and you want to do it again... hi!
